test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Among the four figures listed, three of them follow a common rule and one does not. Select the odd one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe58c50f31c62378c47574c73be1d7e8deb5b21d5415ff73b6f63c4f3a9a47f3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

__
 
• The outer polygon sides increases + 1 from figure A to B, B to C and C to D.
 
• The inner polygon sides increases + 1 from figure A to B, B to C, **But inner polygon sides decreases - 2 from figure C to D.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5562c1be8b7223a4183212381a0ac8a7e0c2072246d1a858abfe61c2eaa20ea.png] 

∴ Here, figure D is different from the other three alternatives.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] Alternate Method__**

In figure A → + 1 side in increased from outer polygon to inner polygon.

In figure B → + 1 side in increased from outer polygon to inner polygon.

In figure C → + 1 side in increased from outer polygon to inner polygon.

**In figure D → - 2 sides are decreased from outer polygon to inner polygon.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"D".**
